Disclaimer: Please note that the contribution of stubble burning to Delhi's PM2.5 concentration for a particular day is determined using active fire count data from the VIIRS satellite-based instrument received on the evening of the previous day. The uncertainty especially related to the detection of fire events from satellites, will be carried forward in the estimated contribution of stubble burning to Delhi's PM2.5 pollution.

The forecast for the contribution of stubble burning to Delhi's PM2.5 concentration over the next three days relies on climatological data for fire count and emissions.
